semantic_verdicts: Import is limited deliberately to a personal schema-1 document <=2MB, one setup/version, 100 coffees, 2000 shots, 500 families; retired Experiment records rejected without silent loss.
Preview calls import inside a caught PostgreSQL exception block, so all preview INSERTs are rolled back; a reviewed identical-file hash and positive recovery gate are required before save.
Source document is stored only in the private import batch table; existing saved member workspace is not overwritten by first importer. No private row content read in this audit.

Historical shot snapshot arrives as validation input; BEFORE INSERT capture_equipment_snapshot reconstructs immutable persisted equipment snapshot, and protect_shot_provenance prevents subsequent accidental hardware/coffee reassignment.

Imported shots are tagged legacy_import, and remember_feed_condition explicitly skips their feed preference mutation, so textual import timestamp iteration cannot itself alter remembered slow-feed setting.

Coffee submission remains private/pending until separate verification. Canonical verification backfill checks dialed-in rating; existing hidden-shot behavior is historical compatibility needing product evidence before any cleanup, not inferred as a defect.

Read-only production aggregates: 1 import batch, 14 legacy import shots, 0 hidden shots, 0 hidden green shots, 0 hidden linked green shots, 0 verified submissions. No demonstrated live hidden Community anomaly.
No verified new reproducible incorrect behavior or measured bottleneck from these already-reviewed SQL bodies, so no speculative rewrite or index deletion.
